[[Jedur Wahmeh]] is the selfish youngest child of [[Nehbawa Wahmeh]], a well-respected elder of the farming village in Issnur Isles. His elder brother is [[Mutu Wahmeh|Mutu]] and his elder sister is [[Misela Wahmeh|Misela]].

==Dialogue==
:''"My father was a fool! He worked his entire life to amass a fortune, and then gave it away to simpletons who couldn't earn their own way. They took advantage of him and he worked himself to death trying to help them."''

During quest [[Jedur, the Youngest Child]]:
:''"You made a great choice. I plan to use the family fortune to buy my way into power. But don't worry, I won't forget you! What? Don't you want to be rich? I know I do. And you know why? So I can be more important than my brother and sister. Nyaaah."''

After quest [[Jedur, the Youngest Child]]:
:''"Hey! Wait until you see my new ship. When it's done, I'll hire a crew and become a world famous [[corsair]], plundering my way to even greater riches. Then I can start my own nation of 'Jeduria', a counter dedicated to the wonders of me!''

:''I'll show my father I was the best child all along! Your reward? Come to Jeduria when it's founded and I'll find something for you... if you bring enough gold..."''
